admission.justification: Guarded by CompactToolResultWireTests and prevents breaking start-tree wire byte parity, explainer schema-less responses, or reintroducing private _convert_to_content monkeypatching.

applicability: Every normal tool return value and early-return guard refusal converted to CallToolResult in AgentsRememberMCP.
conditions: build_call_tool_result emits compact UTF-8 JSON text blocks and schema-validated structured_content for dict[str, Any] tools while keeping bare-dict explainer tools without outputSchema or structured_content.
build_early_refusal_result preserves indented JSON text and structured_content for explainer forged-seat and stale-build early refusals.
exclusions: Application-layer tool_response.py, which imports no MCP SDK types and stays transport-independent.

evidence: pytest mcp/tests/test_compact_content.py mcp/tests/test_suite_load_independence.py + compare_wire_baseline.py vs start-tree-wire-baseline.json

statement: The retired compact_content monkeypatch is replaced by build_call_tool_result in tool_results.py, constructing compact UTF-8 JSON CallToolResult objects in the MCP adapter while keeping <name>DictOutput schemas on dict[str, Any] tools and no output schema or structuredContent on the four explainer tools.
title: MCP adapter builds compact CallToolResult and indented early refusals directly
